title: The Shade of the Market Umbrella
youtube_title: The Shade of the Market Umbrella | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Quinn sees that a circle of shade under the market umbrella will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Quinn makes a smaller, even share so Farah is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
